# relationship interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/relationshipInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)

The time interval over which an interpersonal relationship held. (A relator carries its period this way rather than via [`duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md), which is reserved for [gufo:Situation-based](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Situation-based) time-scoped relations.)
